summary: Frontend-only structural tests for Shred Legend (#/shred-legend) feedback round. Verified: new PUNK FROG charlie-punk logo in intro card AND in #/play menu tile; 7 distinct crowd characters (Finn/Chunk/Jazzy/Charlie/Lou/Stew/Dr. Jellybone) with similar rendered heights (123-140px band); meter fills gradually to ~19.6% after a 2.5s single-pad hold (within 15-20% target); song name HUD renders; randomness confirmed with 4 unique songs across 5 successful mounts (Garage Stomp, Surf Riot, Kindie Riot, Alley Cat Strut x2); timer decrements (44s->39s) and no runtime console errors on start; BEND bar visible in Notes mode and absent in Chords mode (chord grid shows instead); playing screen renders fully with stage lights, meter, crowd and guitar. Jam Session (#/free-play) regression: guitar-instrument present, BEND in Notes mode, chord/notes/clean/crunch toggles callable, note pads tappable, no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing duplicate-key React warning observed on shred-legend load (ignored per request). Consider auditing crowd/stage array keys to eliminate the warning.
Welcome-to-JMA name modal often re-appears across hash navigations in automation. Not a bug for users, but may indicate the skip flag read happens pre-hydration; harmless.

Random-on-mount can produce back-to-back same song across page reloads (observed Alley Cat Strut twice). Spec intent (no back-to-back) applies to the result-card 'New Song' replay path which uses beginReady(true). Confirmed via code review of ShredLegendPage.js.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AudioUnlockOverlay dismissal MUST come before shred-start click. localStorage jma_player_name_skipped_v1='1' survives reload() but Welcome modal sometimes re-mounts after multiple hash navigations in Playwright; dismiss by clicking the 'I'll add my name later' link if needed. Measured crowd img heights: Finn 128.8, Chunk 140, Jazzy 123.2, Charlie 134.4, Lou 126, Stew 137.2, Dr. Jellybone 140 (all within ~15% band). Meter width after 2.5s hold on guitar-note-4: 19.6% (gradually rising).
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found for the requested feature set.
